set.body: PLSNeuro NativeStudyProbe initial bilateral named surface is blank even after three rendered frames, while a later remount after FIR selection shows both meshes. /private/tmp/plsneuro-common-maps-rendered-final.log terminal0 but visual acceptance fails: /private/tmp/plsneuro-common-maps-rendered.png.named-surface.png blank; .sampling.png renders both. Native source inspection: JavaFxSurfaceProbeResult.setViewportSize updates cached viewportWidth/Height and configureLayout, but attachCamera only sets camera and stores scene; JavaFxSurfaceBackend.newSubScene supplies initial dimensions. Consumer binds width/height after creation, often starting from collapsed width1. Likely cached viewport dimensions remain stale on resize; initial-world-camera issue not yet independently excluded. Reproduce through native public backend by creating a small SubScene then resizing it, compare layout/snapshot to creation at final dimensions; implement general resize synchronization and lifecycle handling in provider, verify direct JavaFX and downstream bilateral initial rendering. Do not use an application-specific camera nudge workaround.
set.title: Keep JavaFX surface layout synchronized with SubScene viewport resizing
